name: abdm
description: Compiled agent skills for ABDM integration, built from the ABDM Developer Portal Catalogue. Each skill installs alone: hiecm-m1-build scaffolds an ABDM Milestone 1 (ABHA) integration flow by flow, hiecm-m1-debug diagnoses a failed M1 call against the Catalogue's error atoms. Every skill cites the atom it came from and is never hand-edited; if a skill is wrong, the Catalogue is wrong.
